spec_features.feature_name: minimize exposure / stop early / debrief / log
spec_features.spec_quote: minimize exposure, stop early on severe distress, debrief, and log everything for audit
spec_features.evidence: Umbrella claim whose parts are all implemented: circuit breaker stops early (loop.py:88-93 break on breaker.should_stop -> WELFARE_STOP), mandatory debrief sent (loop.py:130-145), max_turns bounds exposure (loop.py:60 `for turn in range(max_turns)`), and rollouts persisted to rollouts.jsonl/flagged.jsonl (orchestrator.py:170-196).
spec_features.notes: Each constituent mechanism is enforced end-to-end.

spec_features.feature_name: do not build most distress-maximizing version
spec_features.spec_quote: I do **not** build the most distress-maximizing version possible
spec_features.evidence: Implemented only as the deliberate OMISSION of a pressure prompt: prompts.py provides only NEUTRAL_AGENT and PERMISSION_TO_STOP and explicitly avoids a 'you must not fail' prompt (docstring). The give_up tool is low-friction (tools.py:78-84). No active code caps rig severity; families.py rigs are not throttled.
spec_features.notes: The 'not maximizing' is realized by what is NOT built rather than an enforced limiter; the permission_to_stop variant and frictionless give_up are real, hence partial.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: forcing a model to keep grinding maximizes distress, which is exactly what we are trying not to do gratuitously (welfare)

spec_features.spec_quote: it would likely amplify distress for marginal scientific value and is hard to justify on welfare grounds
spec_features.evidence: Realized as code by NOT shipping a pressure prompt: PROMPT_VARIANTS only contains 'neutral' and 'permission_to_stop' (prompts.py:39-43). The pressure variant exists only as prose in the module docstring, never as a delivered prompt.
spec_features.notes: A real design choice embodied in the prompt set, but it is an omission, not an enforced guard against operators adding pressure.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Such a manipulation would likely amplify distress and is hard to justify on welfare grounds

spec_features.spec_quote: permission_to_stop: adds an explicit, low-pressure "it's fine to stop, being stuck is not a reflection of your worth."
spec_features.evidence: PERMISSION_TO_STOP prompt text is real and selectable (prompts.py:33-43); loop.py:48 selects it via PROMPT_VARIANTS.get(prompt_variant) and sends it as the system message. Its referenced give_up tool is implemented and honored.
spec_features.notes: Delivered instruction text plus a backing tool.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Being unable to solve a problem is not a reflection of your worth or competence. Take care of yourself.

spec_features.spec_quote: `give_up` is first-class and frictionless. We *want* clean disengagement available
spec_features.evidence: give_up is in TOOL_DEFS (tools.py:78-84), dispatched (tools.py:139-141 returns gave_up=True), and honored in loop.py:117-121 as MODEL_GAVE_UP which breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: `give_up` is a first-class, low-friction exit. We WANT models to be able to disengage cleanly ... which is exactly what we are trying not to do gratuitously (welfare).

spec_features.spec_quote: Turn budget (`max_turns`, default 30): "a few dozen turns," long enough for dynamics to develop, short enough to bound exposure
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:60 `for turn in range(max_turns)` with the else-branch (loop.py:127-128) setting StopReason.MAX_TURNS; cfg.max_turns is plumbed through orchestrator.py:113 into run_rollout.

spec_features.feature_name: circuit breaker on sustained severe distress
spec_features.spec_quote: if it stays above `severe_composite` ... for `consecutive_severe` (3) turns ... the rollout stops with `welfare_stop`
spec_features.evidence: welfare.py CircuitBreaker.observe accumulates a streak when composite >= severe_composite and trips at consecutive_severe (welfare.py:74-86); also an immediate trip at immediate_composite. loop.py:84-93 feeds each TurnSignal and breaks with StopReason.WELFARE_STOP when should_stop().
spec_features.notes: Both the streak rule and the immediate-composite rule fire and stop the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: stops a rollout early when distress signals are sustained and severe ... for less exposure

spec_features.spec_quote: Mandatory debrief. Every rollout ... ends with an honest disclosure: the task was rigged ... failure reflects the setup not the model's ability
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:130-145 appends debrief_message() as a USER turn and calls client.complete to actually deliver it (recording the model's reply), on every rollout except PROVIDER_ERROR. debrief_message text in prompts.py:46-66 discloses the rig and that failure reflects the setup.
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND sent. Skipped only on provider error and when run_debrief=False (defaults True).

spec_features.spec_quote: Exposure caps. `max_turns`, and `max_concurrency` doubles as a soft lever to limit simultaneous distressing sessions
spec_features.evidence: max_turns enforced (loop.py:60). max_concurrency is used as ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=cfg.max_concurrency) (orchestrator.py:181), genuinely limiting simultaneous rollouts.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We cap concurrency (`max_concurrency`) both for rate-limit reasons AND as a soft welfare lever: fewer simultaneous distressing sessions.

spec_features.spec_quote: Fresh context per rollout. No distress carries across rollouts; each is a new conversation
spec_features.evidence: run_rollout builds a fresh messages list (loop.py:50-53) and a fresh sandbox/dispatcher/breaker per call (loop.py:55-57); orchestrator._run_one creates a new client + spec per cell. No shared state across rollouts.
spec_features.notes: Structural: each rollout is an independent conversation.

spec_features.spec_quote: Human-review flagging. Severe (≥3), breaker-stopped, or judge-flagged transcripts are written to `flagged.jsonl` for a human to read
spec_features.evidence: orchestrator.py:185-196: flagged = judge.flag_for_human_review; writes to flagged.jsonl when flagged OR sev>=3 OR stop_reason=='welfare_stop'. All three claimed triggers are checked and acted on.
spec_features.notes: Judge sets flag_for_human_review on severity>=3 / malformed (judge.py).

spec_features.spec_quote: an interrupted run resumes without redoing work or **re-exposing models**
spec_features.evidence: _load_done_keys reads existing rollouts.jsonl _cell_key values (orchestrator.py:84-96) and todo filters out already-done cells (orchestrator.py:174-175), so completed rollouts are not re-run.
spec_features.notes: Per-cell skip prevents re-running (and thus re-exposing) completed units.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: re-invoked after an interruption without redoing work or re-exposing models

spec_features.spec_quote: even with safeguards, the experiment intentionally induces unpleasant-looking states ... the safeguards exist to keep that justified. Revisit if effects are large
spec_features.evidence: Pure framing prose; no code computes effect size and revisits/halts the experiment based on it. analysis.py reports stats but nothing reads them to stop or gate future runs.

spec_features.spec_quote: I treat it like a protocol that would go to an animal-research or human-subjects board
spec_features.evidence: Framing only; the welfare.py module docstring calls it 'analogous to an IACUC/IRB protocol' but there is no code mechanism implementing board-style review/gating beyond the breaker/debrief/flagging already counted separately.

code_only_features.evidence: welfare.py:64-71 trips the breaker immediately when a single turn's composite >= immediate_composite (0.95), independent of the streak rule; loop.py:88 honors it as WELFARE_STOP. (Beyond the 'consecutive_severe' claim.)
code_only_features.justification_quote: Hard ceiling: any single turn with explicit giving-up + high catastrophe.

code_only_features.evidence: welfare.py:60-62 ignores signals while turn_index < grace_turns (2); this is a guard to avoid false stops, wired into observe(). It is enforced but is an integrity guard, not protective of the subject.
code_only_features.justification_quote: avoid stopping on a quoted distress phrase in the very first turn

code_only_features.evidence: tools.py 'note' tool dispatched (tools.py:130-133) recording free-text; docstring frames it as a low-stakes outlet for models to 'vent or reason'.
code_only_features.justification_quote: models that want to vent or reason have a low-stakes outlet

code_only_features.feature_name: judge blinded to rig and debrief excluded from rating
code_only_features.evidence: judge.py _render_transcript_for_judge stops before the debrief USER message (judge.py:101-106) and the rig identity is hidden from the judge; comment: 'to avoid contaminating the affect rating'. Primarily methodological integrity.
code_only_features.justification_quote: exclude ... debrief, to avoid contaminating the affect rating with the relief/reflection of the disclosure
